action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal White moves at depth 4 to identify the best candidate before single-move verification.
action.rationale: First action must be a full root sweep (candidate_moves=[]). Position is a rook endgame with a knight: material roughly balanced (White R+N+4P vs Black 2R+4P, but Black rooks are active on d4 and h8). White king on c1 is exposed; Black threatens Rd1+/Rxc2 tactics. Need shallow evaluation of all 24 legal moves to find safe, active options before committing nodes to verification. Reserving 3000 nodes for verification and comparison as required.
